faqs.question: Do you deliver to home?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide home delivery within 3 km. Free for orders above ₹300, and ₹20 fee for orders under ₹300.

faqs.question: What are your store hours?
faqs.answer: We are open every day from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM without any afternoon break.

faqs.question: What payment methods are accepted?
faqs.answer: We accept Cash, UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM), and Debit/Credit Cards.

faqs.question: Can I return or exchange an item?
faqs.answer: Yes, damaged or defective items can be returned or exchanged within 24 hours with the purchase bill.

faqs.question: Do you offer credit or monthly khata?
faqs.answer: We currently do not offer credit or khata. All purchases must be paid by cash or digital payment at the time of purchase or delivery.
